name: @pipeworx/mcp-asrs-reports

tools.name: asrs_search
tools.description: Search NASA ASRS (Aviation Safety Reporting System) de-identified aviation safety incident reports by keyword, with optional filters. Answers "find reports about runway incursions", "ASRS reports mentioning bird strikes near a given airport", "fatigue reports involving commuter flight crews". Matches the query against each report's narrative, synopsis, topic and coded anomaly. Returns, per report, the ACN (Accession Number), date, airport/state, aircraft, flight phase, synopsis and a narrative excerpt — call asrs_report with the ACN for the full narrative. Covers NASA's thirty standing curated Report Sets (up to 50 reports each on a fixed safety topic, such as runway incursions, CFIT, bird strikes, NMACs, icing, fatigue), not NASA's full database — call asrs_topics to see which topics and date ranges are covered before concluding a topic has no reports.

query.description: Keyword(s) to search for in the report narrative, synopsis, topic and coded anomaly, e.g. "runway incursion", "bird strike", "fatigue". Multiple words require ALL of them to appear (not necessarily adjacent).

date_from.description: Only include reports from this year-month or later, e.g. "2024-06" or "2024". Reports are dated by the month ASRS recorded them.

date_to.description: Only include reports up to this year-month, e.g. "2025-01".

aircraft.description: Filter by aircraft/operator category substring, e.g. "widebody", "commercial fixed wing", "helicopter".

phase.description: Filter by flight phase substring, e.g. "taxi", "landing", "initial approach", "cruise".

tools.name: asrs_report
tools.description: Fetch one NASA ASRS aviation safety report by its ACN (Accession Number) — the full de-identified narrative plus every coded field (date, airport, state, aircraft, flight phase, coded anomaly types, contributing factors) and the official synopsis. Use after asrs_search returns a report's ACN and you need the complete narrative rather than the excerpt.

acn.description: The report's ACN (Accession Number), e.g. "2093064". Returned by asrs_search.

tools.name: asrs_topics
tools.description: List the thirty safety topics NASA ASRS Report Sets cover (runway incursions, CFIT, bird strikes, fatigue, icing, NMACs, and so on), each with its report count and when NASA last updated that topic's Report Set. Use before asrs_search to check whether a topic is covered at all and how current it is, so a search returning nothing can be told apart from a topic this pack does not track.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-asrs-reports forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the asrs-reports pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
